laws.rule: Queensland does not issue international driving permits; check the destination's licensing rules, and get an IDP from the motoring club if needed, carrying your Queensland licence with it.
Vehicle registration can be renewed online from overseas; renew by the due date to avoid a late fee. An expired registration makes the vehicle unregistered and driving it is an offence.
For Queensland state elections, eligible voters who are overseas can vote by telephone during the early voting period.
